# Purpose

This R Markdown file documents the `sales_eda.R` script. The script performs exploratory data analysis on a synthetic retail sales dataset. It loads the data, handles basic cleaning, produces summary statistics by region and category, and generates visualizations to support quick insights.

# Inputs

- File path to the synthetic CSV (`data/synthetic_sales.csv`)
- Required packages: tidyverse and lubridate

Example data structure (synthetic columns):

- `date` — character or date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `region` — character (e.g., North, South, East, West)
- `category` — character (e.g., Electronics, Clothing, Home)
- `sales_amount` — numeric
- `units` — integer

# Outputs

- Cleaned tibble ready for analysis
- Summary table of total sales by category
- ggplot2 bar chart of sales by category
- Optional monthly trend line chart

# Code Examples

## Load and Clean Data

```{r load-clean, eval=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

sales <- read_csv("data/synthetic_sales.csv") %>%%
  mutate(date = ymd(date)) %>%%
  filter(!is.na(sales_amount), sales_amount > 0) %>%%
  mutate(
    month = floor_date(date, "month"),
    region = factor(region)
  )
```

## Summarize by Category

```{r summarize, eval=FALSE}
category_summary <- sales %>%%
  group_by(category) %>%%
  summarise(
    total_sales = sum(sales_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_units = sum(units, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_sale = mean(sales_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%%
  arrange(desc(total_sales))

print(category_summary)
```

## Visualize Results

```{r visualize, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(category_summary, aes(x = reorder(category, total_sales), y = total_sales)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2E75B6") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Total Sales by Product Category",
    subtitle = "Synthetic Retail Data",
    x = "Category",
    y = "Total Sales Amount"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
